title: Optim-Account: Unleashing dApp innovation with a composable account-based virtual ledger layer

ms.promise: Non-technical documentation of the Mainnet Beta of Leviathan (Optim-Account) by Optim Labs. This will include explanations at a high level of core mechanics and use cases for non-technical users. These described concepts will be extended and integrated into content production of marketing and education materials for promotion of Leviathan in Milestone 2. Our initial marketing plan will formalize decision making regarding the production and distribution of these materials. Accompanying the marketing plan will be finalization of brand identity for the Leviathan.
ms.criteria:
Non-technical Gitbook for users outlining the Leviathan system architecture, core mechanics, and use cases.
・Description of system design, components, and flow of user funds within system
・Use cases and explanation of benefits to the end user in comparison to current status quo of transaction execution on Cardano
・One example of a theoretical application and how its inputs, transactions, and eventual settlement would move within the Leviathan system. 

Marketing Plan detailing how resources will be allocated to production and promotion, and how they will be tracked for accountability purposes

ms.promise: Technical development documentation for smart contract extension requirements for Cardano dApps integrating into Leviathan. Comprehensive written Technical Gitbook, with available corresponding system components on Github, created for the purpose of software developer education and onboarding for the Optim Account: Leviathan system.
ms.criteria:
・Technical Gitbook detailing Leviathan design philosophy and methodology for solving existing scalability and throughput bottlenecks on Cardano. Provides details on:
・System architecture
・Smart contract requirements
・Modular contracts design patterns
・Implementation best practices
・Github repository containing completed-to-date open-source Leviathan smart contracts to be used as an educational resource for developers. This will likely not be the Leviathan code in its final form, but it will be useful in getting developer community familiar and up to speed with design patterns.
